page.layout: One page of text in a single column, full width. Running head at the top, page number at the top left. No margin notes. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: grammatica præcepta solicitat. Angelos esse credunt, resurrectionem mortuorum. Menses ex visione lunæ sanctificant. Pascha primumque mensem in terra Israëlis ex maturitate spicarum pronuntiant: Extra terram Cyclum Rabbanistarum sequuntur. Ridet hoc Gamalielis pronuntiatum, annum intercalari propter tria, propter spicas, tecuphas, & fructus arborum; ridetque adhuc magis quod alii addunt, propter agniculas hondum Paschati satis grandes, pontes effractos, &c. rationem hanc reddit. וירוע כי בהמבא האביב איו אפשר שאיו הכל מתוקנים ולמה נוסיף על דברי אלהים חיים licet sequuntur Rabbanistarum computum, ridet tamen eorum ἀφιεργίας[?] in בדו[?] ba-du Pascha non celebrari, id est, v. 4. & 6. feria. בח principium esse non posse anni, &c. & demonstrare nititur ex Esdra, Pascha celebratum fuisse in בדו[?] differentiæ sunt aliæ plurimæ, quantum ex isto libro, tum ex variis Judæorum libris collegi, sed hanc unam præ cæteris con-

page.notes: The Greek word after "tamen eorum" and the Hebrew word "בדו" after "in" are hard to read; the scan is blurred. The Hebrew line "נוסיף על דברי אלהים חיים" is partly obscured by printed boxes and may be misread. The third Hebrew line is set in the same line as "licet". The page number "522" is uncertain (the first digit could be 3). The catchword "fidero" is blurred; it may be "sidero" with a long s, the end of the word "confidero" after "con-". The printed "tria, propter spicas" has a small mark between the words, which I did not transcribe.
